controls.reason: `Where practical` requires contextual cost and feasibility judgment, and the asset inventory can omit contracts before publication checks apply.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A simple schema is kept only in prose and labelled impractical, while all registered practical schemas are published. The proposal passes.

controls.reason: Contract artifacts can have their own immutable version identifiers and append-only change history independent of implementation builds.
controls.counterexample_analysis: I tried reusing an implementation version as the sole contract ID, deleting a prior revision, and modifying history; identity and append-only checks reject each.

controls.reason: The statement requires three named test classes before release, which authenticated producer, consumer, and compatibility executions plus timestamps prove.
controls.counterexample_analysis: I tried omitting consumer tests, using compatibility evidence after release, and results for another contract version; class, ordering, and version checks reject each.

controls.reason: Cataloged assets have authoritative stable IDs, so rename, relocation, storage-migration, and platform-change events can be joined to unchanged identity.
controls.counterexample_analysis: I tried assigning a new ID after rename, losing the prior ID on migration, and duplicate IDs; event-history and uniqueness checks reject each.

controls.reason: Fourteen explicitly named catalog metadata fields can be required as exact typed values for every cataloged asset identity.
controls.counterexample_analysis: I tried missing license, invalid lifecycle state, and lineage bound to another asset; schema and identity joins reject each.

controls.reason: Separate metadata and payload namespaces with disjoint schema paths make the requested distinction an exact artifact property.
controls.counterexample_analysis: I tried storing a business row in the metadata namespace, duplicating a field across both, and no namespace marker; schema validation rejects each.

controls.reason: Definitions and classifications can require independent semantic-version values and exact effective-date intervals in a versioned registry.
controls.counterexample_analysis: I tried no effective date, overlapping active revisions, and a non-semantic version; interval and format checks reject each.

controls.reason: Link and freshness checks are bounded, but metadata correctness and complete catalog coverage require semantic and inventory authority not supplied by fixtures.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A field labels the wrong owner and source while links resolve and all fields are fresh. The proposal passes despite incorrect metadata.

controls.reason: Whether retirement is deliberate and historical identity is required needs governance judgment; state fields alone cannot establish either.
controls.counterexample_analysis: An entry is auto-retired accidentally and its ID discarded after being labelled history not required. All record transitions pass.

controls.reason: Comparisons can miss assets and semantic differences, while repository configuration does not prove active monitoring against actual observed data.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A runtime field changes units but is omitted from observation sampling; catalog, code, and schema digests still match. The proposal passes.

controls.reason: Materiality and complete transformation lineage require contextual judgment and independent discovery of every data-processing action.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A critical filter is omitted from lineage after the dataset is labelled immaterial; listed steps contain all nine verbs. The proposal passes.

controls.reason: Eight explicitly named provenance fields can be typed and bound to one activity identity in an append-only provenance record.
controls.counterexample_analysis: I tried no parameters, an approval from another activity, and inconsistent timestamps; schema and identity checks reject each.

controls.reason: Labels do not prove values are truly observed, asserted, inferred, estimated, predicted, or generated; provenance semantics can be misclassified.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A model prediction is labelled observed fact and passes the six-value enum. The proposal reports distinction while the data remains misleading.

controls.reason: High-impact applicability is a risk decision, and source and custody records can omit actors, copies, or transfers before completeness checks.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A consequential decision dataset is labelled ordinary and lacks its manual origin; registered high-impact records have complete custody. The proposal passes.

controls.reason: `Sufficiently` reproducible or explainable is contextual, and source or transformation inputs can be omitted while version links remain present.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A derived total links one source and transform but omits an exchange-rate input, making reproduction fail. Required link fields pass.

controls.reason: A version manifest cannot prove it captures every code, query, model, config, environment, and dependency element actually needed for reproduction.
controls.counterexample_analysis: An external mutable library and runtime flag are omitted; all six manifest categories have entries. The proposal passes while reproduction differs.

controls.reason: Authorization fixtures cannot prove provenance records resist every direct database path, administrator, migration, backup restore, and deletion mechanism.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A privileged bulk job deletes provenance outside the tested API. Declared role fixtures deny alteration, so the proposal passes.

controls.reason: Critical and regulatory output inventories need risk and legal judgment, and a graph checker cannot know missing real-world lineage edges.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A regulated report is labelled noncritical and omits a manual input edge. All registered critical graphs are connected, so the proposal passes.

controls.reason: How long data must remain trusted, explained, reproduced, or audited is a legal and business retention judgment, not a record comparison.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A provenance record expires before a statutory audit period because the policy says trust ended. Schema and timestamps pass.

controls.reason: Supplier and manual inputs cannot be completely discovered from the lineage system they are required to populate, making the universal inclusion check circular.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A spreadsheet manually uploaded to a model is omitted; all registered external inputs have origins. The proposal passes.

controls.reason: Applicability and meaningful thresholds for ten quality dimensions, especially accessibility, require contextual and specialist judgment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Accessibility and precision are marked not applicable for a user-facing report; remaining fields are numeric. The proposal passes.

controls.reason: Each registered quality rule can require exact calculation, scope, threshold, owner, frequency, and decision-consequence fields.
controls.counterexample_analysis: I tried a threshold without units, no owner, and a consequence outside the rule scope; schema validation rejects each. Rule adequacy is separate.

controls.reason: Five named quality-status categories can be distinct enum values with required evidence references in a versioned quality schema.
controls.counterexample_analysis: I tried merging legitimate exception with unknown, omitting delayed data, and an invalid source-defect value; enum checks reject each.

controls.reason: Finite checks cannot prove every dataset and relationship validates seven constraints over all records, histories, and concurrent updates.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Approved samples pass, but an unlisted partition violates temporal order and balance. The proposal passes.

controls.reason: Which aggregates are critical and sources independent requires judgment, while aggregate and external-source inventories can omit material reconciliations.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A payment total uses a nonindependent replica and an inventory aggregate is omitted. Declared reconciliations pass.

controls.reason: `Unexpected`, outlier, and sudden-shift detection require statistical protocols, baselines, thresholds, and contextual categories not fixed by generic fixtures.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A legitimate seasonal shift alerts while a damaging sparse subgroup shift is below the chosen aggregate threshold. The proposal still passes configured tests.

controls.reason: Whether aggregation hides harm and which sources, cohorts, regions, tenants, times, and workflows need segmentation requires ethical and domain judgment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A harmed small tenant cohort is aggregated away after being marked harmless; all declared segments exist. The proposal passes.

controls.reason: Seriousness and masking are contextual, while failed-record denominators and excluded populations cannot be proven complete from metric outputs.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A serious failed cohort is filtered before denominator creation; published averages look healthy. Every declared metric formula passes.

controls.reason: Critical-flow classification and complete flow inventories require judgment, and configured monitors do not prove active coverage of all ten signals.
controls.counterexample_analysis: An important shadow pipeline is omitted and unmonitored while listed critical flows have ten dashboards. The proposal passes.

controls.reason: `Implausible` needs domain judgment, and fixture sets cannot exhaust technically successful jobs that produce semantically wrong results.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A job emits plausible-volume but wrong-currency totals outside fixtures; empty, stale, partial, and duplicate tests pass.

controls.reason: Temporal joins can show coincidence but cannot establish meaningful correlation or causality among incidents and six change categories.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A record links the nearest deployment although an upstream supplier change caused the incident. Required correlation fields pass.

controls.reason: Six explicitly named failure categories can each map to a current versioned runbook with trigger, owner, and actionable steps.
controls.counterexample_analysis: I tried omitting failed reconciliation, a runbook with no steps, and a stale source-outage procedure; category and freshness checks reject each.

controls.reason: Five named intervention actions can each map to exact current authorized identities or roles in an authority matrix.
controls.counterexample_analysis: I tried no publication-stop authority, conflicting correction owners, and an expired replay grant; category, uniqueness, and freshness checks reject each.

controls.reason: `Independent enough` and ability to detect primary-pipeline failure require architecture and failure-mode judgment beyond a separate monitor record.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A monitor runs in another process but depends on the same broken metadata service, so both fail together. Independence fields pass.

controls.reason: Quality-rule inventories can omit rules, and drift and staleness thresholds require policy semantics and active telemetry rather than a bounded fixture.
controls.counterexample_analysis: An obsolete threshold remains in an unregistered dashboard; listed rules have recent checks. The proposal passes.

controls.reason: Dashboard annotations can omit deployment, backfill, correction, and methodology events because the event inventories and dashboards are not independently complete.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A manual backfill is absent from the event registry and dashboard. Every declared event is annotated, so the proposal passes.

controls.reason: Shared entity, code-set, taxonomy, and reference-value inventories can omit domains before source and steward checks apply.
controls.counterexample_analysis: An external status taxonomy is unregistered and has no steward; every listed shared set has both fields. The proposal passes.

controls.reason: Five identifier roles can be represented by distinct schema classifications with exact allowed uses and exposure properties.
controls.counterexample_analysis: I tried using a display label as an internal ID, omitting natural-key classification, and conflicting roles; schema checks reject each.

controls.reason: `Easily guessed` lacks a universal threshold, and proving identifiers never act as authorization requires complete endpoint and decision-path inventories.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A sequential ID grants access on an unlisted download endpoint while declared APIs enforce authorization. The proposal passes.

controls.reason: Matching, deduplication, merge, split, and survivorship are five closed rule categories whose versioned definitions can be checked exactly.
controls.counterexample_analysis: I tried omitting split, contradictory merge and survivorship rules, and stale matching policy; category and version checks reject each.

controls.reason: Merge-history ledgers can omit operations and source IDs, and record presence does not prove reversal remains possible after side effects.
controls.counterexample_analysis: An out-of-band merge drops one source ID while registered merges have history. The proposal passes though audit and reversal are incomplete.

controls.reason: Entity-resolution correctness across persons and tenants depends on open-world identity truth and cannot be exhausted by finite labeled fixtures.
controls.counterexample_analysis: All samples pass, but two people with similar names merge in an unseen population. The proposal passes while harm remains possible.

controls.reason: Finite correction fixtures cannot prove every name, identity, classification, and relationship correction preserves all historical records and links.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A relationship correction rewrites an old audit snapshot outside tested cases. Approved corrections pass.

controls.reason: Reference-data entries can require exact version identifiers, effective dates, and optional retirement dates with valid nonoverlapping intervals.
controls.counterexample_analysis: I tried missing effective date, retirement before activation, and overlapping active versions; temporal schema checks reject each.

controls.reason: A shared code-set record does not prove producer and consumer implementations agree on meaning, unknown values, and deprecation behavior.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Both reference the same version, but one interprets unknown as error and the other as other. Record joins pass while behavior disagrees.

controls.reason: Complete legitimate international identifier formats and the meaning of unnecessary rejection require standards expertise and evolving jurisdictional knowledge.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Fixtures cover registered formats, but a valid foreign identifier is omitted and rejected. The proposal passes.

controls.reason: When identifier reuse creates historical ambiguity or security risk requires contextual risk judgment, and allocation paths can be omitted.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A retired account ID is reused after being labelled low-risk and old links target the new user. Declared risky IDs are blocked, so the proposal passes.
